Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building ages, sizes, portables, and detailed site plans; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; uses multiple data sources including facility audits and engineering assessments; connects condition data to student outcomes and instructional priorities; identifies immediate and long-term needs integrated into capital planning (Appendix A, Facility Condition Assessment, pages 2-60).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides comprehensive enrollment analysis with detailed methodology including birth rates, housing development, and cohort survival model; detailed capacity utilization data by site and grade; connects capacity analysis to specific facility actions including grade reconfiguration and additional classrooms; proposes removal of portables and modernization; includes long-term projections and adaptive strategies (Part Two, pages 10-18).

Educational Alignment.justification: References educational goals and some programmatic needs such as CTE and grade reconfiguration; however, lacks detailed educational specifications or comprehensive connection between facility projects and educational programs; limited discussion of specialized spaces or technology integration beyond basic mentions (Plan overview and Part Three).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Mentions play areas, athletic fields, and baseball fields at multiple sites; includes some site size and density analysis; however, minimal detail on greening strategies, shade, permeable surfaces, or districtwide greening plans; no explicit connection to climate resilience or outdoor learning (Part One, pages 5-7).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: No mention or assessment of climate risks or climate readiness; no strategies for mitigating climate impacts included in the plan.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes data on energy use and mentions solar farm at multiple sites; discusses HVAC upgrades and electrical system improvements; references energy efficiency projects and some energy resilience goals; however, lacks comprehensive strategies for electrification, decarbonization, or detailed resilience planning; no explicit reference to Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Facility Condition Assessment and site descriptions).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates for modernization, capacity expansion, and portable removal; includes itemized costs with soft costs and contingencies; outlines multiple funding sources including State School Facility Program, developer fees, bonds, and alternative financing; provides prioritization framework and discusses funding gaps and strategies to address them; aligns financial capacity with facility needs (Part Four, pages 22-27).
